harnessNotes.*: Maestro delegates every step. Load the model preferences and the provider catalog before choosing a worker. Paseo can drive Claude, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, Cline, Cursor, Kilo, Hermes, Antigravity, Muse, and ACP providers. Read references/harness/adapters.md before the first spawn, and record the worker chat id before the first prompt.
harnessNotes.cursor: Cursor can return a resumable chat id from its subagent tool and the Cursor CLI resumes with --resume; use whichever path gives a chat id you can prompt again.
harnessNotes.claude: Claude Code subagents run through the Task or Agent tool. For a chat you can re-enter, use claude -p --session-id <uuid> and claude -p --resume <uuid>.
harnessNotes.antigravity: Antigravity runs through the agy CLI, easiest via Paseo's antigravity provider. It uses full access only; every tool call runs without asking.
harnessNotes.opencode: OpenCode and Kilo share the same session flags: opencode run --session <id> and kilo run --session <id> continue the recorded chat.
harnessNotes.cline: The Cline CLI runs a prompt with cline "<brief>" --json -m <model> and resumes with cline --id <session-id>. It auto-approves tools by default; prefer --worktree.
harnessNotes.kilo: Kilo shares the OpenCode CLI shape: kilo run --session <id> continues the recorded chat, and -m selects the worker model.
harnessNotes.kiro: Kiro has no standard resumable CLI session. Use a worker CLI from the adapter table when reviews must return to the same chat.
harnessNotes.codex: Codex records a session id in codex exec --json output and resumes it with codex exec resume <session-id>.
harnessNotes.copilot: Copilot has no standard resumable CLI session. Use a worker CLI from the adapter table when reviews must return to the same chat.
harnessNotes.muse: Muse Code is a Paseo native provider. Use list_models and create_agent; direct CLI support varies.
